text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—For as long as the horsegirls desire to
run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And...
to let them run in good health and high
spirits.
choice_data_list: (I swear this on my Trainer's badge.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had resolved this the very day I passed
through the gates of Tracen Academy.
The kind of Trainer I wanted to be—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: *Haah... haah... haah...—*

text_block_list.name: Participating Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Like I'm gonna lose...! Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Every day at Tracen Academy,
mock races are held.
For pre-debut horsegirls,
it is a precious chance to gain real racing
experience—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And for a rookie Trainer like myself,
it is a crucial scouting ground to find the
horsegirl I will train in the future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Her timing for shifting into top gear was
off.
...No, before that,
she hadn't conserved enough stamina.
In that case—
choice_data_list: (The intensity of a real race trul...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume is always at her most serious
during a race.
Seeing them run only reaffirmed to me that
their strengths—and physical vulnerabilities—
are most apparent out on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate,
I wanted to learn about as many Umamusume
as possible.
I resolved to watch mock races whenever I
had a spare moment—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A few days later.
At another mock race.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...! Ngh...!!
choice_data_list: (That Umamusume... I'm pretty sure...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing the same Umamusume competing in
consecutive mock races isn't necessarily
that unusual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Things like that happen," I thought at the
time. But—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—
choice_data_list: (...!? Her again...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted her again in another race.
Once it happens a second or third time,
it becomes a different story entirely.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: —All right, just watch me...!
choice_data_list: (Just how many times has she run t...
(How many races is this for her...?!）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And when it repeated too many times to count,
my eyes couldn't help but follow her—
choice_data_list: (—Ikuno Dictus.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was the name I had seen over and over
on the race sheets up until today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Looking back,
Ikuno Dictus had participated in nearly
every single mock race I had watched
recently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're "mock" races,
they are run under real race conditions.
The fatigue must be immense. And yet,
she keeps running with almost no intervals
between them...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she's pushing herself to run back-to-back
like this,
she could suffer a career-ending
injury...!
choice_data_list: (I need to go check on her right n...
(I have to check on her right away...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—... My spurt timing has improved.
All that remains is adjusting my positioning
right before making a move, and—
choice_data_list: Ikuno Dictus!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Yes? How may I assist you?
choice_data_list: I know this is sudden, but could y...
I know it's sudden, but would you ...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: An examination? May I ask why...—
choice_data_list: You've been in a lot of mock races...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
That explains why you went out of your way
to call out to me.
I appreciate your concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Talking to her like this,
she doesn't appear to have any problems.
Though naturally fatigued right after a race,
her demeanor is completely normal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However,
injuries can occur in areas imperceptible
to the naked eye.
It's dangerous to simply settle for "she
seems fine."
choice_data_list: For the sake of your future, I'd r...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. In that case,
I shall go undergo an examination
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Afterwards,
I asked the school nurse to conduct an
examination on Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Her health seems to be in excellent
condition.
From an internal medicine perspective,
there appear to be no abnormalities.
choice_data_list: Could you also check for fatigue i...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given how many mock races Ikuno Dictus has run,
the strain on her lower limbs must be
considerable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I asked the nurse to check for any
irregularities in joint alignment and other
key areas using my own custom checklist—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...You conduct quite a meticulous check.
That checklist appears exceptionally thorough
as well.
choice_data_list: I always want to assess conditions...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I see...! That is highly educational.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...So, what is the verdict?
Are there any apparent issues with my physical
condition?
choice_data_list: As for issues, well... I believe t...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honestly,
I couldn't believe it.
Her body was in such stable shape that it
was hard to believe she had been running in
an absurd succession of races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What a relief.
Thanks to this,
I feel even more confident in my current
management strategy.
choice_data_list: ...Management?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Managing mind and body to maintain
optimal condition,
competing in as many races as possible
without setbacks,
and achieving my "objective"—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is self-management for that exact purpose.
...For all my races up to today,
I have managed my condition in this
manner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the "management" system Ikuno Dictus
presented,
I was left completely speechless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training regimens,
daily routines like meals and sleep,
equipment status, environmental factors—
it was an overwhelming amount of information
for a single individual to track and
manage—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of these variables were meticulously
recorded day by day,
complete with contingency plans for any
possible fluctuations in each metric.
choice_data_list: —You've been doing all of this on ...
—You put all of this together by y...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Currently,
I am adjusting my training and lifestyle
protocols on the premise of running consecutive
mock races.
choice_data_list: ...Since when have you been practi...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ever since enrolling.
I have maintained these records,
if you would care to see them?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted,
I took a look at the logs stored on her device.
Spanning from her enrollment to this very day,
not a single daily entry was missing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were clear traces of extensive effort,
constantly updating tracked parameters to
enhance the precision of her
management...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I was utterly astonished.
Her self-management techniques, mindset,
and the sheer willpower to execute them far
surpassed the level of an ordinary
student...!
choice_data_list: (What incredible talent and dedica...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
thank you very much for the thorough
examination today. If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it,
I was running after Ikuno Dictus as she left
the infirmary.
choice_data_list: Ikuno Dictus!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: Do you plan on continuing to run a...
Are you going to keep running at t...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To run more than anyone else,
and to grow stronger through that experience.
...I believe that is the training regimen
that only I can undertake to achieve my
"objective."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes held no hesitation as she spoke.
What burned within them was an unyielding—
an ironclad glint of determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
I stood frozen in place until Ikuno Dictus,
striding forward without a trace of doubt,
disappeared from view—
